examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('small, little').
Common feminine noun meaning 'number, figure, digit' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Что это за маленькие цифры в отчёте?
examples.trans: What are these small numbers in the report?
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?
Now I will check the reports.

examples.text: Шеф, наш разведчик вернулся с отчётом.
examples.trans: Chef, our scout has returned with a report.
Why are we going so slowly?

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?
So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?

examples.text: Подождите! Два дня — это же очень мало.
examples.trans: Hold on! Two days is far too little.

meanings.note: plural only: there is no singular in everyday use

examples.trans: The money is on the table.
Gum? I didn't have enough money.

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.note: at home, a party, or a restaurant

examples.trans: All the guests love them very much.

examples.text: Сегодня вечером к нам придут гости.
examples.trans: Guests are coming to our place tonight.
A plot next to Grigory Soprykin.
Right nearby, round the corner, there's a cheburek café.

открыться.gloss: to open, to come to light

meanings.en: to come to light, to be revealed

examples.trans: New circumstances have come to light.

examples.text: Прошу внимания. Открылись новые обстоятельства по другому делу.
examples.trans: May I have your attention. New circumstances have come to light in another case.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('new').

examples.text: Ну что, довольна? Теперь новую работу искать.
examples.trans: Well, happy now? Now I have to look for a new job.
We went to an Italian restaurant.
They called from the Italian restaurant.

examples.text: Слушай, Нина, это же тот самый ресторан!
examples.trans: Listen, Nina, this is that very restaurant!

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.
They called from the Italian restaurant.
Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

examples.text: Теперь я начальник нашей стройки. Ты уволен!
examples.trans: Now I'm the boss of our building site. You're fired!

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to do, to make', paired with 'сделать'.

examples.trans: Hi, Arkady Borisovich. What are you doing?

meanings.en: it is necessary, one needs to
meanings.note: + dative of the person + infinitive: мне нужно позвонить

examples.trans: I need to make a call.

examples.text: Мне нужно позвонить губернатору. Дай телефон.
examples.trans: I need to call the governor. Give me a phone.

meanings.note: to provide food for someone or something

examples.trans: The cook feeds the guests a delicious lunch.

examples.text: Быстро беги на кухню и корми людей!
examples.trans: Quickly run to the kitchen and feed people!

examples.text: Ты кормишь рыбу лучше наших гостей.
examples.trans: You feed the fish better than our guests.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.text: А что я за мэр такой, который держит своё слово?
examples.trans: And what kind of mayor would I be if I kept my word?

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('big, large').

examples.text: Аракелян просит время. Сумма очень большая.
examples.trans: Arakelyan is asking for more time. The sum is very large.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'емья'). Common feminine noun meaning 'family' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Так, семья Самсоновых. Он строитель, она медсестра.
examples.trans: Right, the Samsonov family. He's a builder, she's a nurse.

meanings.note: hesitation, at the start of a sentence

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

meanings.note: + genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice
the plural is a different word: люди, людям, о людях

examples.trans: There are a lot of people here.
I know the problems of ordinary people.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.

тащить.gloss: to drag, to pull, to carry, to bring

examples.trans: Then run, go grab a clothespin quickly!

examples.text: Тащи свою птицу су-шефу на стол!
examples.trans: Drag your bird to the sous-chef's table!

meanings.note: Core Russian pron meaning 'they' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Ты преподавай. А они пусть строят свои торговые центры.
examples.trans: You teach. And let them build their shopping centres.
The white one? Give me the keys.
How much power does this car have?

examples.text: Да, по-моему, здорово! Сколько сил в этой машине?
examples.trans: Yes, I think it's great! How much power does this car have?

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Prefix 'вс-' ('up') marks upward or sudden onset of action (stem 'егда').

examples.trans: She's offended. She's always like that.

meanings.note: agrees in gender and case with the noun

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.
I'll definitely buy you a tank.

examples.text: Государство обязательно увидит и назначит операцию.
examples.trans: The state will surely see and will schedule the surgery.

придумать.gloss: to think up, to come up with

meanings.en: to think up, to invent, to come up with
meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'думать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to think up, to come up with', paired with 'придумывать'.

examples.trans: You came up with this yourself!

examples.text: Как нет? Ты же сам это всё придумал!
examples.trans: What do you mean, no time? You came up with all this yourself!

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('good, nice').

examples.text: Какое хорошее утро! Лидия Алексеевна, чашку кофе, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: What a lovely morning! Lidia Alekseyevna, a cup of coffee, please.
I am forced to cancel my decision.
We have already made a decision.
I can see the toy car.

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

meanings.note: работать + instrumental = to work as: работать мэром

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been working as mayor for four years now.

meanings.note: остаётся у нас = stays with us

examples.trans: And the advance stays with us.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

meanings.note: professional associate (common gender, declined like feminine)

examples.text: Мой коллега помог мне с отчётом.
examples.trans: My colleague helped me with the report.
